title: Vault Combination Locator
description: A secure digital vault requires you to find the exact index of a given secret code within a strictly sorted, unique-element database of passcodes. If the code exists, return its index. Otherwise, return -1.
constraints: All the integers in codes are unique.
codes is sorted in ascending order.
input_format: A sorted array of integers codes and an integer target.
output_format: An integer representing the index of the target, or -1 if not found.

examples.explanation: 9 exists in codes and its index is 4.
2 does not exist in codes so return -1.
Target matches the single element at index 0.
